definitions.explanation: the quality of being refined, polished, and tastefully elegant

examples.japanese: ⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗練|せんれん}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{惹|ひ}かれた→惹く：27838_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I was drawn to the sophistication of the design.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洗練|せんれん}さ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{力強|ちからづよ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{共存|きょうぞん}→共存：11675_kyouzon⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
Formed by adding さ (nominalizer) to ⟦{洗練|せんれん}→洗練：06468_senren⟧ (refinement/polish). While ⟦{洗練|せんれん}→洗練：06468_senren⟧ can function as a noun on its own, the さ form explicitly emphasizes the quality or degree of refinement. Often used in discussions of design, fashion, art, cuisine, and culture.

- {洗練|せんれん}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack refinement
- {洗練|せんれん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: sophistication shines through
- {洗練|せんれん}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to seek refinement
